test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The given line graph shows the data of Mango exports in India from year 2018 to 2021. Study the given line graph and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23165774ed615629f995d42e91649043bfc36bef58d906a39d5aa4c306a12da3.png] 

In which year was the value per hundred units the minimum?
solution:
**Calculation:**

According to the question:

In 2018, 460/390 = 1.179

In 2019, 370/280 = 1.32

In 2020, 350/280 = 1/25

In 2021, 450/350 = 1.28.

**So, in 2018 the value per hundred units is minimal.**
